description: Dragon Phonics rules from fixed inputs. `rounds`: buildRound (src/data/phonicsRounds.js) with rng = createSeededRandom(seed).next from a fresh generator per case, shared in draw order across the whole round (element picks first, then each item's word and options in turn); elements and options are element keys; `count` null means the default. `words`: pickPhonicsWords(level, 10, rng) then buildOptions(entry, optionCount, rng) per word, one fresh generator per case (src/data/phonicsWords.js). `missingSoundKeys`: curriculumKeyFor for each Missing Sound word, and `chosen` maps each tile of its pool to curriculumKeyFor of the word with that tile in the blank. `mastery`: server/lib/phonicsMastery.js; attempts are newest first, judged at `now`.

classifyElement.name: learning: too few attempts for solid
solid: exactly the attempt floor and accuracy
solid: perfect but one mode only
solid: two modes but too few attempts for mastered
solid: two modes but accuracy below mastered
mastered: exactly the attempt floor, two modes
mastered: nine of ten across three modes
solid: a mode only counts when answered right
mastered: old misses fall out of the window
learning: old successes fall out of the window
solid, stale: unpracticed past the limit
mastered, stale: unpracticed past the limit
solid, not stale: exactly at the limit
solid: unparseable last-seen date is never stale

progression.description: Attempts in arrival order. Each step is classifyElement(historySoFar newest first, now = that attempt's createdAt). `later` judges the whole history at `later.now`.
